items.title: How sustainable is the AI investment boom after Thursday’s selloff?
items.summary: Investing.com -- The artificial intelligence investment boom is becoming increasingly difficult to sustain at its current pace as technology companies pour billions of dollars into infrastructure without a corresponding acceleration in revenues, raising the risk of an eventual spending slowdown that could weigh on economic growth, Capital Economics said.

items.title: Josh Brown Warns Alphabet Stock “Could Go Down 50%.” Here’s Where He’d Buy It
items.summary: Key TakeawaysJosh Brown said on The Compound and Friends that Alphabet stock “could go down 50%” if Google’s search share slips just 2%, and that he’d buy at $213 to $215. A 2% slip in Search would cost Alphabet about 1% of its revenue, so a 50% drop would have to come from investors paying a much lower multiple for its earnings.
